READER district-prepared-01-cold-forage You see a frost lichen crust.

A small, finite stand of frost lichen. Brew its
cold into a freezing coating, then quench a melee
weapon beside a forge. Drinking the coating freezes
the drinker.

READER district-prepared-03-native-forge You see a tinker's forge.

The roadside forge still works. Carried weapon
components can be forged or used to re-forge a
weapon. A brewed coating can quench a weapon here;
frost lichen supplies the cold for freezing
coatings.

READER district-06-cellar-directions You see a gleaners' cellar tally.

Fire clay was kept in the far supply crate for the
well above. The broad passage is shortest, but
fresh marlback scratches cross it. A narrow service
passage turns north behind the wall. Its fallen
beam can be hauled from the western shoulder; the
winding passage beyond that shoulder stays open.
The stair returns to the glade. These marks promise
supplies, not safety.
